title: SAT Test Day, Start to Finish: What to Bring and What to Expect
description:
Everything that happens on SAT test day, in order: what to bring, what to leave home, arrival and check-in, the tools in Bluebook, both sections, the break, what to do between modules, and when your scores come out.

You'll learn:
• The must-bring list (and the ID rules that get students turned away)
• What's prohibited, and what happens to your phone
• Arrival times and how check-in works
• Every Bluebook tool: timer, mark for review, option eliminator, highlights and notes, Desmos, reference sheet, question menu
• Pacing checkpoints for both sections
• How to reset after a hard module
• Submitting, the Congratulations screen, scores, and free score sends

Test-day facts come from College Board's own pages (SAT Suite and Bluebook). Rules can change, so check them again before your test. This video has no practice questions; any examples shown are original SAT-style questions written for this video, not official College Board questions.
